observations: about 30 % of the crates are on the normal course; the perfect lives in the red-gem course and the bonus
the gem course needs a key from another stage (Snow Go red gem, reached via Air Crash's secret warp)
each camera mode gets its own crate trick: stair pile, into-the-screen pocket, crates behind foreground rock, float line over an ice slope, crates in disc lanes
Aku crates precede new hazards (hedgehogs, disc gauntlet)
explosives are taught in order: TNT with a life, self-clearing TNT wall, TNT as key/timer, single Nitro, Nitro rhythm on collapsing bridges, Nitro linked to an enemy, green ! last
on ice, misses cost a climb back instead of a death
switches are placed after their outlines so rooms are used twice
both guides name the count traps (into-screen pocket, hidden trio, bonus outlines)
lives come from height and secrets
